[Manual 11.4 — Visitors]
House manual > 11. House Rules > 11.4 Visitors

Day visitors are welcome **between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM**. Every visitor must register at the Gate 2 guard desk with a CNIC or passport, and you must collect them from the gate. A maximum of **4 visitors** may be in your apartment at the same time. **No overnight visitors** are allowed: anyone who sleeps over must be a registered guest on the booking and counts toward the maximum occupancy (section 2.1).

[Manual 2.4 — Security deposit (direct bookings only)]
House manual > 2. Booking Rules, Fees and Policies > 2.4 Security deposit (direct bookings only)

For **direct bookings** (booked with us and not through a platform) we collect a refundable security deposit of **PKR 25,000**. Pay it by bank transfer or mobile wallet (Easypaisa or JazzCash) at least 24 hours before arrival. The host sends the payment details. After you check out and we inspect the apartment, the deposit is refunded to the same account within **3 business days**, minus the cost of any damage or fees described in section 11.7.

For bookings made through **Airbnb or Booking.com** we do not collect a deposit. The platform's own damage-protection rules apply instead.

It is a popular picnic spot spread over 50 acres with a lake and rowboats, motorboats, children's park, swimming pool, cafeteria, canteen and rest houses

48 Hiran Minar (About 35 km away, near Sheikhupura). A peaceful rural park with a lake and minaret. It used to be favourite hunting sport of the Muslim kings, especially the Mughals. Jehangir erected the pavilion-like monument to commemorate the death of his pet deer (Hiran means deer). It served a double purpose as from its top the hunters could locate the habitations of deer. It is a beautiful picnic as well as a historic spot. A high Bara Dari Ghat is constructed right in middle of a Talab. A man made big lake, boating facility is also available. A good garden lay out is surrounding the place. (updated Feb 2017)
